acceptanceCriteria: Each Core-supported tuple passes install, discovery, context, expansion, change, frontier, degradation, upgrade and uninstall cases.
Uncloseable and untested tuples remain FALLBACK or UNSUPPORTED and do not inherit another tuple result.
Adapters retain no independent knowledge store and cannot broaden Core authority.
body: Qualify the narrow maintained host set selected by V1-0001. Expansion beyond it requires its own current matrix.
title: Qualify supported host lifecycle tuples
